Name: Unlikely Friendships
Author: 0dysseyLotus
Description:
[center][color=#ffff00]﻿Please tell me your thoughts, ideas, and comments! I'm welcome to all feedback!

[/color][/center]Well, well, well, hello again! As I was working on a much bigger project than this one (coming out soon, hopefully), I was having a bit of trouble coding the events for it. So I decided to pause it for a bit and try my hand at this little project. I had a lot of fun and I have many ideas to come, so I'll be adding to it in the future with new combinations of characters!

[center][b]Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿[/b][/center]

[center]========================================================================================

[size=4][b]Unlikely Friends[/b][/size]

========================================================================================[/center]
It always felt strange to me that some of the characters just flat out never interact, despite the potential that certain combinations have. So, turning the [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1CpDrw23peQiq-C7F2FjYOMePaYe0Rc9BwQsj3h6sjyo/edit#gid=239695361]Event Modding Resource[/url] and the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Event_data]Event Data[/url] page on the [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Stardew_Valley_Wiki]Stardew Valley Wiki[/url] (very helpful, highly recommend), I got to work creating some of them. It was exhausting, going through each event multiple times to fix bugs and typos, but I did it. While I can say that I am now sick of seeing them, I think (or hope) that you guys will enjoy it.


[center][size=3][b]New Character Combos[/b][/size][/center]
Like I said earlier, the way the characters feel so distant from each other bothers me. You have Sam, Sebastian, and Abigail, Alex and Haley, Harvey and Maru, etc... but seemingly only in those groups and/or pairs. One thing I've enjoyed in games such as Rune Factory was seeing the characters interact with each other. So I thought up some scenarios where people from different groups would interact with one another and slapped them together! (It was a bit more technical than that but you get the point.)


[center][size=3][b]Schedule Changes[/b][/size][/center]
This is [b]Unlikely Friends[/b], and friends hang out with one another. Not all events will have the characters change their schedule, but a few of them will. The events that trigger these are pretty explicit with their message, so you should be able to catch onto whether or not there is a schedule change.


[center][size=3][b]Events[/b][/size][/center]
Thus far, there are three events that are finished. Click the spoiler to find out what you need to trigger them!

[spoiler][list]
[*]Library, 12:00PM to 6:00PM, Sunday, Monday, Thursday, or Saturday, Sebastian 6 hearts, Elliott 5 hearts, Penny 5 hearts
[*]Haley's House, 9:00AM to 7:00PM, Sunday, Monday, Thursday, or Saturday, Haley 6 hearts, Penny 4 hearts (Haley must already be inside)
[*]Town, 8:00PM to 12:00AM, Sunny, Harvey 8 hearts, Abigail 6 hearts
[/list][/spoiler]
[center][size=3][b]Config[/b][/size][/center]
The config can be used to turn swearing on or off. The swearing is already pretty mild, but I know that kids often play or others might prefer clean language, so I left the option there. Just load the game up and the config file should appear. Put in "Yes" for if you're okay with swearing or "No" if you'd prefer not to see it.


[center][size=3][b]Plans[/b][/size][/center]
As of right now, there are three events featured. However, I have more already planned, each with the characters and scenarios written down. I just have to get around to writing them into the game. If you have any ideas, feel free to comment or DM me. I'll credit you in this description if I use it!

[spoiler]Emily and Krobus, Sam and Alex, Shane and Alex, Sebastian and Maru, Haley and Leah, Emily and Abigail, Krobus, Jas, and Vincent, Haley and Abigail, Linus and Wizard[/spoiler]

[center][size=3][b]﻿Installation Instructions[/b][/size][/center]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[*]Download and extract the mod.
[*]Drag the contents into the Mods folder.
[*]You're all done!
[/list]
